analysis.summary: The PR introduces a breaking change by removing a function parameter and its associated logic, while failing to implement the feature ('isSEM') described in the PR title.

bugs.title: Breaking change and functional regression in VAT validation
bugs.description: The function signature of 'validatePersonalVatNumbers' was changed to remove the 'mapThroughEuFormats' parameter. This will cause parameter mismatches at call sites. Additionally, the logic for 'de-DE' (Germany) that allowed cross-EU VAT validation when this flag was true has been completely removed, resulting in a functional regression.
bugs.risk: Existing callers passing the third argument will have it ignored, potentially breaking German VAT validation flows that rely on checking all EU formats. Furthermore, the PR title claims to add 'isSEM' logic, but no such parameter or logic exists in the code, suggesting an incomplete or incorrect implementation.

notBugs.reason: Changing 'it-IT' length from 12 to 11 is likely a bug fix, as the Italian Partita IVA (VAT number) is standardly 11 digits.
Adding '^' and '$' to Swiss (CHE) regexes is a functional improvement that prevents partial string matches from passing validation.
